title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia in a formal role by May 18, 2027

Polymarket asks the same return (any formal role: executive, board or formal adviser) by March 31, 2027 and by December 31, 2027. May 18 falls between them; I read it at a constant daily hazard. The board said on Nov 17 it 'does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO' and has hired a search firm, so nothing on the calendar concentrates the chance inside the window.
